notes.title: K.O.M.A Update Notes - Version 1.2 [Added Smooth Locomotion]
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34608743/3cc467f9630fb9e5bb00eec15835bd1b1fcff903.jpg[/img]
[b]Hello everyone![/b]


[h1]We just pushed out a new update based on the feedback you have shared with us, and included some game improvements as well:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Smooth Locomotion
[*] Added New Steam Achievements
[*] Added New Hints
[*] Added New Settings/Features
[*] Added New Sounds and Elements 
[*] Bug Fixes 
[/list]

[h1]Special Instruction Notes for Oculus Rift Users: [/h1]
[list]
[*] Before using  [b]Smooth Locomotion, [/b] first choose between two options: Righ-hand or Left-hand control.  Use one hand thumb-stick to move, while other thumb-stick to turn left or right. 
[*] Press Y or B button to wake up. 
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34608743/f06e2ef4e821d4cc87b863403039f41a3ec1382a.jpg[/img]

We monitor all channels for new issues and feedback, so we can improve and evolve with your help.
[i]- Thanks, team ENNO[/i]
